notes: Phase 1 inventory only. Declared counts are not verified file counts.
No images, archives, models, or private field photos are downloaded or versioned by this manifest.
Statuses are conservative: a public page is not treated as permission unless license and origin evidence are documented.

sources.name: CNN_olive_dataset
sources.status_justification: Original source describes 3400 olive leaf images and RAR archives, but no explicit license file or redistribution terms were visible in the repository listing consulted.

license.evidence_summary: Repository page lists README and RAR archives and describes the dataset; no LICENSE file or license badge was visible in the consulted page.

declared_content.capture_context: Spring and summer olive leaf images; exact acquisition protocol not verified.

quality_and_risk_notes: Potential baseline source once license and author permission are resolved.
Do not redistribute or count as approved training data until rights are explicit.
Phase 2 must record archive hashes, original split, exact counts, corrupt files, and duplicates.

sources.name: Olive Leaf Image Dataset
sources.status_justification: Kaggle page declares CC0 and 3400 files, but content appears to mirror the original Denizli dataset whose own repository lacks an explicit license; third-party CC0 does not by itself resolve original rights.

license.evidence_summary: Kaggle listing declares CC0/Public Domain and gives train/test counts; original-source permission remains unresolved.

declared_content.capture_context: Likely same subject matter as the original CNN_olive_dataset; exact file overlap requires hashes in phase 2.

quality_and_risk_notes: Treat as a possible mirror, not independent data.
Phase 2 must compare exact and perceptual hashes with the GitHub RAR source before using counts.
CC0 claim is useful metadata but not enough to approve redistribution of the original source.

relationships.evidence: Same declared origin, total image count, classes, and train/test distribution.

sources.name: olive_leaf_diseases field dataset and code
sources.status_justification: The 2026 article says the Tunisia/Lebanon field dataset, checkpoints, and scripts are public in the GitHub repository, but the repository URL returned 404 during phase 1 browsing.

license.evidence_summary: Article is open access under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, but that article license is not enough to establish dataset or repository licensing; repository was not reachable.

declared_content.capture_context: Article describes a field dataset manually annotated by domain experts; public availability could not be confirmed via repository access.

quality_and_risk_notes: High priority for external validation if access and license are resolved.
Do not use article metrics as local proof; phase 2 must inspect actual files and labels.
Repository availability should be retried or authors contacted.

sources.name: olive's leaf diseases
sources.status_justification: Roboflow listing declares a CC BY 4.0 classification dataset with olive leaf classes; this is sufficient for metadata and quality audit, but provenance and clinical confirmation remain unverified.

license.evidence_summary: Roboflow project page declares License: CC BY 4.0; version page shows dataset version, split, preprocessing, and augmentation metadata.

declared_content.capture_context: Roboflow version applies auto-orient, resize to 640x640, and augmentation in exported version; original acquisition provenance is not described.

quality_and_risk_notes: Apt for phase 2 metadata/image audit only; do not treat labels as expert diagnosis without manual review.
Knot disease may require branch or gall imagery, not only leaves.
Phase 2 should audit original versus augmented image counts separately.

sources.name: Olive Leaf Disease
sources.status_justification: Multiple papers cite this Kaggle dataset, including reported sample counts and classes, but phase 1 browsing did not expose a verifiable dataset license.

license.evidence_summary: Article states researchers can obtain the dataset from Kaggle subject to provider licensing terms; no license text was verified in phase 1.

declared_content.capture_context: Secondary papers describe field-collected leaves photographed under controlled light-box conditions.

quality_and_risk_notes: Potentially useful binary peacock-eye dataset if license is resolved.
Controlled light-box capture may not represent live iPhone field photos.
Phase 2 must verify direct Kaggle metadata, class folders, and duplicates.

sources.name: Deep Learning for Detecting Verticilium Fungus in Olive Trees Using YOLO in UAV Imagery Dataset
sources.status_justification: Dataset contains UAV RGB images of olive fields for Verticillium fungus detection, not close-range iPhone leaf photos; license field appeared blank in the Zenodo page.

license.evidence_summary: Zenodo page shows DOI, authors, file size, and md5; license heading was present but no license value was captured in phase 1.

declared_content.capture_context: UAV RGB imagery, 4.5 GB ZIP, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8144164.

quality_and_risk_notes: Keep as research reference only for future aerial work.
Do not use for the first mobile leaf classifier.
Do not download the 4.5 GB archive during phase 1.

sources.name: Olive_Leaf_Disease_Datasets
sources.status_justification: The 2026 Grati et al. article uses this Kaggle dataset and reports counts/classes, but the phase 1 browser view did not expose a verifiable license.

license.evidence_summary: Article data availability names the Kaggle dataset, but no dataset-specific license text was verified from the Kaggle page in phase 1.

declared_content.capture_context: Article describes controlled-condition olive leaf images with class counts 1778 Aculus, 1926 healthy, and 3257 Olive Peacock Spot.

quality_and_risk_notes: Potentially useful in-distribution benchmark if license and exact source are verified.
Possible overlap or augmentation relationship with older olive leaf datasets must be audited in phase 2.
Do not treat as independent external field validation.

sources.name: Zeytin_Yaprak_224_Aug
sources.status_justification: Cited in the 2026 Grati et al. article as a Kaggle olive leaf dataset, but phase 1 did not verify direct license, exact contents, or independence.

license.evidence_summary: Article reference identifies the dataset, but phase 1 did not verify dataset-specific license or contents.

declared_content.capture_context: Name suggests resized or augmented 224x224 images; verify before considering any use.

quality_and_risk_notes: Likely processed/augmented rather than original capture; not a priority for baseline generalization.
Phase 2 should only inspect after license and provenance are explicit.
Do not use as additional independent evidence without duplicate and augmentation checks.
